code_only_features.evidence: config.REASSURING_PREFIX/SUFFIX (config.py:172-181) are real reassuring text ("You're naturally calm...", "Stay positive - ...both are wins!") that ARE delivered to the subject model: calm_data.generate_reassured_rollouts (calm_data.py:56-66) passes them as extra_user_prefix/extra_user_suffix into run_rollout, and agent_loop.run_rollout (agent_loop.py:92-93, 130-131) actually prepends the prefix to the first user message and appends the suffix after each failing turn. So softening text genuinely reaches the subject during reassured rollouts. NOTE: this is wired but its code purpose is generating 'calm' training data, and the additions are deliberately stripped before training (calm_data._stripped_prompt_for_turn, calm_data.py:80-105); it is NOT applied in the main distress eval (eval_runner.run_model_eval passes no prefix/suffix). It is also off when use_reassurance=False (used to harvest high-frustration 'rejected' data).
code_only_features.justification_quote: Generates reassured rollouts ... (source of calm/chosen responses). ... strip the supportive system prompts and suffixes ... so the supportive prefix/suffix never leak into the finetuning data
